narrative: 你改变的是背景归属于谁。四分之三侧面（Three-Quarter Angle）可以变成侧面镜头，一扇窗可以取代一面墙，房间的另一半会出现在画面中。
主体始终是中心；滑动的是这个世界。如果你需要的是完整旋转、直线横向平移（Trucking），或者是从固定三脚架上做摇镜头，那这就是错误的工具。
如果半径坍缩了，那就意味着你不小心做成了推镜头。
how: 铺设弧形轨道，或按测定好的半径行走，始终面对人物。保持距离大致恒定。
对大多数覆盖镜头来说，90度就足够了。提示词：a 90-degree arc left around the subject, curved dolly, always facing the figure, background sliding.
when: 用它来改变对话的轴线，或揭示房间的另一半。具体情境：从正面的双人镜头转为侧面镜头，揭示出门口有一个倾听者。
除非奇观效果是本意，否则不要完成整整360度。
vs: 360°环绕会完成整个圆周。右弧形运镜是另一个方向：选择能产生新墙面的那一侧。
推轨左移（Dolly Left）是直线运动，而非曲线，因此除非主体也在移动，否则与主体的距离会发生变化。左弧形运镜则是在固定半径上的部分方位角运动。
examples_film: 《好家伙》用曲线运镜来表现社交氛围的变化，这与其著名的科帕卡巴纳（Copa）直线跟拍镜头不同。《赎罪》中沙滩与宅邸的长镜头段落也包含弧形运镜，以重新调整人群与房间的轴线。
借用的是这个四分之一转向的手法，而不是整段场面调度。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是推轨左移，或者完整的360°环绕。破绽在于：直线轨道让主体脱离画面，或者旋转始终不停下来。
修正方法：曲线路径、恒定半径、大约90度，镜头始终对准人物。

faq.q: What is Arc Left in film?
faq.a: 这是一种局部的向左环绕运动：摄影机围绕主体沿曲线移动，同时始终对准主体，从而改变背景和面部角度。
360°环绕会完成整个圆周，往往本身就成为一个事件。左弧形运镜则是一段覆盖性的曲线运动，通常约90度，用来改变轴线。

faq.q: When should I use Arc Left?
faq.a: 当一场对话或一个房间需要在不剪辑的情况下获得新的轴线时使用。不要用完整的环绕来完成这个任务。

faq.q: How do I prompt Arc Left for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写出如下要素：90-degree arc left, curved dolly, always facing [Subject], constant distance, background sliding。除非你想更换技法，否则应排除完整的360度。

narrative: You change who owns the background. A three-quarter face can become a profile, a window can replace a wall, the other half of a room can arrive.
The subject stays the center; the world slides. It is the wrong tool when you needed a full spin, a straight truck, or a pan from sticks.
If radius collapses, you accidentally pushed in.
how: Lay a curved track or walk a measured radius, always facing the figure. Keep distance roughly constant.
Ninety degrees is enough for most coverage. Prompt a 90-degree arc left around the subject, curved dolly, always facing the figure, background sliding.
when: Use it to change the axis of a conversation or reveal the other half of a room. Concrete beat: from a frontal two-shot into a profile that discloses a listener in the doorway.
Do not complete 360 unless spectacle is the job.
vs: 360-Degree Orbit finishes the circle. Arc Right is the other direction: pick the side that produces the new wall.
A Dolly Left is linear, not curved, so distance to the subject will change unless they also move. Arc left is a partial azimuth on a radius.
examples_film: Goodfellas uses curved approaches as social weather, distinct from its straight Copa track. Atonement 's long beach and house passages include arcing camera to re-axis crowds and rooms.
Take the quarter-turn, not the whole set-piece.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Left or a full 360-Degree Orbit. The tell is a straight track that loses the subject, or a spin that never stops.
The fix: curved path, constant radius, about 90 degrees, lens on the person.

faq.q: What is Arc Left in film?
faq.a: It is a partial leftward orbit: the camera travels a curve around a subject while remaining aimed at them, changing background and face angle.
A 360 orbit completes the circle and often becomes the event. Arc left is a coverage curve, usually about 90 degrees, to change axis.

faq.q: When should I use Arc Left?
faq.a: When a conversation or a room needs a new axis without a cut. Do not use a full orbit for that job.

faq.q: How do I prompt Arc Left for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write 90-degree arc left, curved dolly, always facing [Subject], constant distance, background sliding. Ban a full 360 unless you change technique.
